user.title: Configure Pace
user.description: Choose which CLI speed test backend to use. The next step's server options depend on this choice.

data_description.backend_type: Choose which CLI speed test tool to use: LibreSpeed CLI (self-hostable), Ookla CLI (official, requires accepting Ookla's license/GDPR terms), or speedtest-go (open-source, same server network as Ookla)

server.title: Server & Test Settings
server.description: Set up Pace for network speed testing. This integration will monitor your internet connection speed at regular intervals.

data.fallback_to_closest: Fall Back to Automatic Server on Failure

data_description.server_selection: Select 'Automatic' to use the best server, choose a specific server, or 'Custom' to use your own (LibreSpeed and speedtest-go backends only - Ookla has no self-hosted server option)
data_description.auto_update: When enabled, speed tests will run automatically at the specified interval
data_description.scan_interval: How often to run automatic speed tests (minimum 30 minutes, maximum 24 hours)
data_description.start_time: Optional: align the schedule to a wall-clock time (e.g. '00:00' plus a 1 hour interval runs on the hour, every hour). Leave blank to just run every interval starting from setup.
data_description.test_timeout: Maximum time allowed for a single speed test to complete (60-600 seconds)
data_description.connectivity_check_interval: How often to check internet reachability and public IP, independent of speed tests (10-300 seconds)
data_description.source_interface: Optional: bind the speed test to a specific network interface on this Home Assistant host (e.g. 'eth0'). Only affects this machine, not other devices on your network.
data_description.source_ip: Optional: bind the speed test to a specific source IP address on this Home Assistant host. Only affects this machine, not other devices on your network.
data_description.fallback_to_closest: If a test against the configured server fails, automatically retry once using the closest/automatic server instead of giving up
data_description.isp_download_speed: Your ISP's rated download speed, used to calculate plan compliance (leave at 0 to disable)
data_description.isp_upload_speed: Your ISP's rated upload speed, used to calculate plan compliance (leave at 0 to disable)
data_description.auto_register_cards: When enabled, bundled dashboard card files are automatically copied to /config/www/pace and registered as Lovelace dashboard resources. When disabled, the card files and resources are removed.

cli_download_failed.title: CLI Download Failed
cli_download_failed.description:
The CLI binary could not be downloaded automatically. This may be due to network connectivity issues or firewall restrictions.

You can:
• Try downloading again using the repair flow
• Switch to a different backend in options
• Check your internet connection

custom_server_unreachable.title: Custom Server Unreachable
custom_server_unreachable.description:
Your custom server at {server_url} is currently unreachable. This could be due to:

• Server is temporarily down
• Network connectivity issues
• Incorrect server URL
• SSL certificate problems

To fix this issue, go to {options_path} and:
• Update the server URL
• Check SSL certificate settings
• Switch to automatic server selection

repeated_test_failures.title: Speed Tests Repeatedly Failing
repeated_test_failures.description:
Speed tests have failed {failure_count} times in a row. This may indicate:

• Network connectivity issues
• Server compatibility problems
• Backend performance issues

Recommended solutions:
• {backend_switch}
• Try automatic server selection
• Check your internet connection
• Review Home Assistant logs for details

circuit_breaker_open.title: Circuit Breaker Activated
circuit_breaker_open.description:
Speed tests have been temporarily disabled after {failure_count} consecutive failures to prevent system overload.

{manual_test}

To resolve:
• Check your network connection
• Verify server availability
• Review error logs for specific issues
• Consider switching backends
